name: Knights of Columbus Hall, Lynbrook
aliases: Knights of Columbus Hall 78 Hempstead Ave
St. Mary's / Maris Stella Knights of Columbus
description: The meeting and party hall of the Lynbrook Knights of Columbus (Council 2228), a Catholic service group. The hall holds 50 to 200 guests and hosts fundraiser parties with bands, holiday dances, bingo and line dance classes.

dancing.notes: The hall advertises a large dance floor. Its calendar includes four-week line dance classes with a professional teacher, a line dance social fundraiser, a Christmas party with music and dancing, and band nights. Many events need tickets bought in advance.

evidence.note: Official hall rental page: room for 50 to 200 guests and a large dance floor.
Official calendar: line dance lessons in fall 2026 and early 2027, a March 2027 line dance social, a December party with dancing, and a Risky Business night on Nov 7.
Official contact page with the 78 Hempstead Avenue address and the hall phone number.
